system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: For each node,AgentSkillOSconstructs an execution prompt that restates the user task, specifies the skill to invoke, and clarifies the sub-task.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-node prompt assembled from task, skill, upstream artifacts; code not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: It also lists upstream artifacts (i.e., files produced by prior nodes) with brief usage hints, states the expected outputs
env_context_strategy.note: Upstream artifact listing injected; node execution by Claude Code which navigates with tools (inferred). Skill retrieval via tree/vector is for skills, not repo.

context_compaction.note: Delegated to Claude Code; harness mechanism not in evidence.

tool_call_format.note: Execution via Claude Code Agent SDK; parser not in evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the task-specific agent equipped with the selected skills executes the nodes according to the DAG's layered dependencies
loop_primitives.note: Default orchestrator dag; free-style (Claude Code react loop) reachable via --orchestrator.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Compose and orchestrate multiple skills into a single workflow with a directed acyclic graph, automatically managing execution order, dependencies, and data flow across steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: while each DAG node is executed by the Claude Code Agent SDK withclaude-sonnet-4.5
multi_agent_topology.note: Planner LLM builds DAG, each node run by separate Claude Code agent; up to max_concurrent=6 parallel.

delegation_mechanism.note: Per-node agent executions inferred from paper Sec. 2.2.3.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: A built-in GUI enables human intervention at every step, making workflows controllable, auditable, and easy to steer.
human_in_loop.note: User selects among DAG plans; batch mode auto-selects via batch_auto_plan.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: produces a structured summary of execution status and outputs to support inspection

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: this mechanism allows the system to directly reuse the skill orchestration plans in the recipe pool with user consent
long_term_memory.note: Skill tree library plus recipe pool of past DAGs retrieved by vector similarity.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Completed tasks are skipped; only remaining tasks are re-executed.

self_verification.evidence_quote: produces a structured summary of execution status and outputs to support inspection
self_verification.note: Benchmark LLM judge is evaluation, not in-run verification.

retry_policy.note: fixed_n reachable via retry_failed in batch config.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The agent then executes the specified skill, saves all generated files as artifacts, and produces a structured summary

cost_controls.note: Cost tracked (total_cost_usd) but no cap seen.

timeouts.note: Per-node timeout default; execution_timeout per run default 0 (off), config-reachable.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Claude Code (must be installed and available in PATH)

tracing.evidence_quote: Trace each step with logs and metadata to debug faster
tracing.note: meta.json/result.json per task; loguru file sinks.

replayability.evidence_quote: the skill orchestration graph for each task is also stored for reuse in future similar tasks

target_domain.evidence_quote: Tasks require end-user artifacts in formats such as PDF, PPTX, DOCX, HTML, video, and generated images.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Use [cc-switch](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch) to switch to other LLM providers
model_agnostic.note: Planner via litellm; executor tied to Claude Code.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Our GitHub repository is available at: https://github.com/ynulihao/AgentSkillOS.

first_release_date.note: Paper v1 date fallback; no tag info.
